# WK Flash

> An unofficial third-party study app for WaniKani learners. Reviews are Anki-style: meaning and reading on one card.

WK Flash combines meaning and reading prompts on one review card. It sends review results to the WaniKani API using a personal access token entered by the user. The token is stored in the browser and requests are made directly to WaniKani.

## Features

- Review meaning and reading together on one card to cut review volume in half.
- Keyboard and game controller controls that work out of the box.
- JLPT coverage, weakest items from review stats, search, and a level-up forecast.
- Resume an in-progress review offline; answers sync when the connection returns.
- Sort reviews by SRS, level, or type, and prioritize the current WaniKani level.

## Public pages

- `/`: Marketing homepage and, after connecting a token, the review dashboard.
- `/about`: Project description, features, and unofficial-status notice.
- `/how-it-works`: Step-by-step guide to connecting a WaniKani token and running reviews.
- `/jlpt-coverage`: JLPT kanji coverage by WaniKani level, from static curriculum data. No account needed.
- `/jlpt`: Index of JLPT N5 to N1 kanji and vocabulary lists.
- `/jlpt/<level>/kanji` and `/jlpt/<level>/vocabulary` (level is `n5` … `n1`): Kanji and vocabulary lists for each JLPT level, with meanings and readings.
- `/jlpt/kanji/<character>`: Meaning, readings, WaniKani level, and example JLPT vocabulary for a single kanji.

## App pages (not for indexing)

- `/settings`: API token and review preferences.
- `/review`: Active review session.
- `/lessons`: Lesson queue.
- `/analytics`: JLPT and review analytics.

## Important

WK Flash is an unofficial third-party application and is not affiliated with WaniKani or Anki. “Anki-inspired” describes the flashcard workflow only.
